reason: A web workbench for editing and running Jupyter notebooks plus managing a local interactive shell, with documented host-level code and command execution capabilities.

summaries.zh: 提供用于编辑和运行 Jupyter Notebook 以及管理本地交互式 Shell 的 Web 工作台。
summaries.en: Provides a web workbench for editing and running Jupyter notebooks and managing a local interactive shell.

capabilities: Edits and saves Jupyter notebook files
Executes notebook cells through a Jupyter kernel
Starts and manages a real local shell PTY
Runs shell commands with the host user's permissions
Streams notebook and terminal output to the web interface
